scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.verify:design: npm run verify:foundation && npm run test:design-browser
scripts.verify:database: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-foundation.js
scripts.verify:authentication: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-foundation.js && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify:catalog: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-foundation.js && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify:reservations: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-foundation.js && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify:foundation: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-foundation.js
